## 6. De-risking experiments and the cross-epic analysis (2026-09-07)

Experiments ran in scratch worktrees at origin/main 4c77d6f3e96f with the checkout's venv, no tracker writes, worktrees removed afterward.
- Drain fix: see entry 5 (one function; red-then-green; bug live on main).
- Package move (git mv src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler src/rebar/reconciler, no import edits): C901 scores are path-independent (the six moved functions score 32, 20, 27, 27, 16, 23 at both paths); a plain prefix re-spell of the six complexity keys fails --check with "'ceilings' keys must be sorted" and must be rewritten through render_baseline; after the sorted re-spell --check equals the clean tree (active=33 new=0 increased=0 stale=16, the 16 stale rows pre-existing on main); the lock against main's copy prints exactly six NEW-entry lines plus the administrator hint; tests/unit/test_complexity_baseline.py passes (87).
- Test-package rename (git mv tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/unit/reconciler): --check reports new=36 stale=29; the 29 stale are all autouse_fixture under the old path, the 36 new are the same 29 at the new path plus the seven marker-admitted entries already new on the clean tree; no other kind appears, so the story's 29-key list is complete; a prefix-only re-spell keeps the file sorted and restores the clean-tree summary; the reviewer suffix check produces 29 lines each side and an empty diff. rebar._proc.reap_process_group exists at src/rebar/_proc.py:38; tests/_repo_root.py defines repo_root() at line 32; check_complexity_baseline.py accepts --base with --lock.
- MCP tool-surface golden: the planned list_tools() capture is deterministic (three runs byte-identical, 64 tools, 75,422 bytes, 51 with outputSchema and the expected 13 without, zero machine-specific strings); REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM does not change the surface (call-time gate); REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1 drops 27 write and bridge tools to 37, so the capture and the golden test must clear that variable. Recorded on the derivation story.
- pytest-split writes .test_durations under xdist worksteal with full node ids covering every collected test (41 of 41 on a two-module probe; pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, pytest-split 0.11.0).
- Ruff TID251 and TID253 with the planned config are green on the current tip and fire on stdin probes; landing caveat: pyproject.toml's existing per-file-ignores table must be extended, not replaced, or six T201 errors appear.

Cross-epic file-impact overlap (all 49 stories, every file_impact path): 79 real overlap paths, 6 append-only, 4 regenerated. Same-line or adjacent collisions that had no owner and now carry ownership comments on both stories: reads_cli.py:186-207 (overlap vs CLI); llm/config.py and rebar.toml [llm] region (overlap vs eval harness; the overlap story's "config epic owns the rest" sentence was wrong, the co-editor is the eval epic); mcp_server.py:598 vs 599-600 (MCP vs reconciler); schemas/__init__.py enrich entries (overlap vs MCP); config.py:43-87 import block at the 800-line cap (editor vs config); test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py:168 vs 169 (eval vs editor); docs/README.md:142 (overlap vs eval, with the eval story's ownership claim contradicted); tests/scripts/test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py:36 (edited by three stories and deleted by a fourth). Delete-versus-edit orderings recorded: check_mcp_library_parity.py and its test and Makefile line (MCP deletes; reconciler and test-suite edit); src/rebar/llm/overlap/* (overlap deletes; config shim rewrites imports); five seam files the test-suite story deletes that four other stories edit; descendants.py:15 goes F401 when the CLI story deletes its only user. Sequencing: .test_durations is recaptured by the last held-out merge story because the merges change about 170 node ids.

Cite drift since the spec basis: 23 commits between 2e81cb9767c1 and 083620b0 (116 files) and 3 more to 4c77d6f3e96f, most of them comment-condensation commits from the comment-remediation epic, moved lines in files cited by six stories (armed, fuchsia, chivalrous, anguished, decorative, unadhesive). All six were re-verified against the tip and corrected on 2026-09-07 with per-ticket old-to-new comments; the eval story's CodeQL cite points at text that no longer exists (that edit reduces to adding evals/** under paths-ignore); the guarded-pass story's basis parenthetical still assumes the package move, flagged on the ticket.

String-form references for the shim removal: 76 reference lines in 56 files for _engine_support.resolver (59 single-line imports, 3 module-object imports, 1 multi-line module import at tests/unit/test_close_duration_instrumentation.py:27-31 with three monkeypatch.setattr(resolver, ...) sites, 1 multi-line functional import at tests/scripts/reducer/test_ticket_alias_backfill.py:30-34, 5 attribute-access sites with only import rebar, 1 dotted-string monkeypatch target, 8 prose). The two multi-line forms were the ones a single-line grep and the first plan missed; both are now in the story. No monkeypatch of the reducer._processors re-exports exists.
